senses.gloss:
a. 
(-वी f.) [भीरोरिदम् अण्] 
__1 Terrible, frightful, horrible, formidable; बेल्लद्भैरवरुण्डमुण्डनिकरैर्वीरो विधत्ते भुवम् [[U. 5. 6.]] 
__2 Miserable. 
__3 Relating to Bhairava. 
-वः 
__1 A form of Śiva (of which 8 kinds are enumerated). 
__2 The sentiment of terror (भयानक). 
__3 Fear, terror. 
__4 N. of a musical mode (राग) calculated to excite emotions of fear or terror. 
__5 A mountain. 
-वी 
__1 A form of the goddess Durgā. °चक्रम् a disc of the goddess भैरवी; प्रवृत्ते भैरवीचक्रे सर्वे वर्णा द्विजोत्तमाः । निवृत्ते भैरवीचक्रे सर्वे वर्णाः पृथक् पृथक् ॥ [[Utpattitantra.]] 
__2 N. of a Rāgiṇī in the Hindu musical system. 
__3 A girl of 12 or a young girl representing the goddess Durgā at the Durgā festival. 
-वम् Terror, horror. 
-Comp. 
-ईशः an epithet of Viṣṇu (or Śiva ?); so भैरवतर्जकः. 
-यातना a sort of purificatory torment inflicted by Bhairava of Benares on those who die there, to make their spirits fit for absorption into the Supreme Spirit.
